title: Lautaro Martínez ties Agüero: 41 Argentina goals | Inter news, Oct 1
description:
Lautaro tied Agüero. He's still underrated.

CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Oct 1): Lautaro Martínez scored in the 19th minute as Argentina beat Bolivia 4–0 in Córdoba — his 41st goal for his country, level with Sergio Agüero, third all-time.
CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Oct 1): Inter Women play Austria Wien tonight, 12:45 PM ET / 18:45 CEST, in matchday 2 of the Women's Champions League. Disney+ and ESPN UK; no US broadcaster.
REPORTED (Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInter1908, Oct 1): Inter will meet Carlos Augusto's representatives soon about a new deal. His contract runs to 2028. No figures were published.
